name: Academic Cover Letter

position_title.name: position_title
position_title.label: Position Title
position_title.default: Tenure-Track Assistant Professor in Computer Science

opening.name: opening
opening.label: Opening Paragraph
opening.default: Dear Professor Chen and members of the Search Committee,

body_research.name: body_research
body_research.label: Research Statement
body_research.default: I am writing to apply for the Tenure-Track Assistant Professor position in Computer Science. I am currently an Assistant Professor at the University of Technology, where I lead the Systems and Machine Learning Lab. My research sits at the intersection of distributed systems and machine learning, focusing on building efficient, fault-tolerant infrastructure for large-scale ML workloads. My work has been published in top-tier venues including OSDI, SOSP, and NeurIPS, and I have been awarded three NSF grants totalling $1.2M.

body_teaching.name: body_teaching
body_teaching.label: Teaching Philosophy
body_teaching.default: I am deeply committed to teaching and mentoring the next generation of computer scientists. I have developed and taught four courses at both the undergraduate and graduate levels, including a new course on Machine Learning Engineering that grew from 15 to 80 students in two semesters. My teaching evaluations average 4.8/5.0, and I have supervised six PhD students and twelve Master's theses to completion.

body_service.name: body_service
body_service.label: Service & Diversity Contributions
body_service.default: I serve on the program committees of SOSP and EuroSys, and I co-chair the ACM SIGOPS Doctoral Dissertation Award committee. At my current institution, I founded the Women in Computing mentorship programme, which has grown to 120 participants, and I serve on the Faculty Diversity and Inclusion Council.

publications.default:
1. Rivera, A., \textit{et al.} ``Scalable ML Training on Heterogeneous Clusters'' -- OSDI 2025.\\
2. Rivera, A. and Kumar, S. ``Fault-Tolerant Model Serving at Scale'' -- SOSP 2024.\\
3. Rivera, A., \textit{et al.} ``Learned Index Structures for Distributed Storage'' -- NeurIPS 2023.

closing.name: closing
closing.label: Closing Paragraph
closing.default: I am excited about the opportunity to join State University's vibrant research community and contribute to its mission of excellence in research and education. I have enclosed my curriculum vitae, research statement, teaching statement, and three letters of reference. Thank you for your time and consideration.
